response.overview: When Khampun lost one of his childhood friends he made a vow that when he grew up he would go back and teach all of the kids in his village. Once Khampun graduated, he left his love and his life in the capital city to return home in order to fulfill his promise. In his village, however, not everything is as he expected it to be. He finds himself challenged to overcome obstacles and to answer a question that is troubling him.
response.title: My Teacher
